annotations.title: Answer the questions for a property I'm adding

description: Save, on a property the connected person is adding to Fabrica (Sepolia Testnet), the owner named on the deed (owner: one person, an entity with the person who signs for it, or several people with how they hold title) and the answers to the county's questions (answers, keyed by the question exactly as add_land or get_adding_status lists it; a select takes one of its options verbatim). Returns the record as get_adding_status does, with the questions still open: the county's questions depend on the kind of owner, so after saving the owner they are read again from the answer. Needs the connection's add-property grant.

answers.description: Answers to the county's questions, keyed by the question exactly as get_adding_status or add_land lists it; a select answer is one of its options, verbatim. An empty string clears an answer.

email.description: Where Fabrica writes about this property; defaults to the account's email

owner.description: The owner named on the deed. One person: firstName, lastName, email. An entity: entityName, entityType, entityJurisdiction, and the person who signs for it (firstName, lastName, email, role). Multiple: people and qualifier.

email.description: This person's email: the signing session and the documents go there

entityJurisdiction.description: Entity: where it is formed, as US- plus the two-letter state in lower case, e.g. US-tx

entityType.description: Entity: its type, e.g. Limited Liability Company, C Corporation, Trust, Limited Partnership

firstName.description: Legal first name, as on the deed

kind.description: Who holds title on the deed: one person, a legal entity (LLC, corporation, trust...), or two or more people together

lastName.description: Legal last name, as on the deed

middleName.description: Middle name or initial, as on the deed

people.description: Multiple: every person on the deed

email.description: This person's email: the signing session and the documents go there

firstName.description: Legal first name, as on the deed

lastName.description: Legal last name, as on the deed

middleName.description: Middle name or initial, as on the deed

role.description: For an entity: this person's role in it (Manager, President, Trustee...)

qualifier.description: Multiple: how they hold title, as the deed says, e.g. 'husband and wife', 'as joint tenants with right of survivorship', 'as tenants in common'

role.description: For an entity: this person's role in it (Manager, President, Trustee...)

tokenId.description: Token id of the property being added (from add_land or get_my_properties_being_added)

name: answer_adding_questions
